# democraft-mcp - llms.txt

Demo fleet for the 13 ArtCraft apps. One MCP portmanteau (`craft`), one webapp page
per app, every demo a real headless CLI run plus an optional local Ollama step.

## Execution

- Default: headless `<App>\<app>-cli.exe` subprocess, no GUI, artifacts into
  `outbox/<app>/<demo>/` with `run.json` and the engine log.
- Hands-in: the same run can stream over SSE (`POST /api/demos/stream`) and be
  replayed step by step in the webapp (0.25x-4x).
- Missing wrappee: `wrappee_missing`. Missing Ollama: AI step `skipped`, CLI half runs.
- No CLI mocks in tests; tests use a tmp outbox.

## Artifacts

- In: prompts, topics, demo footage, source plates, MIDI.
- Out: DXF/PDF/SVG, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX+GIF, MP4, WAV, `.pcraft`, EDL, PNG/JPG.

## Docs

- `docs/ONBOARDING.md` (start), `docs/WRAPPEE.md` (what ArtCraft is),
  `docs/apps/` (one page per app), `docs/TOOLS.md` (tool reference),
  `INSTALL.md` (all install paths)
- Server: `src/democraft_mcp/server.py` (MCP), `api.py` (REST), `crafts.py`
  (registry + runners), `jobs.py` (job engine), `flows.py` (multi-app flows)
- Webapp: `web_sota/` (React + Vite + Tailwind; 13 craft pages, `/hands-in`,
  `/depot`, `/flows`, `/studio`)
- Full text: `llms-full.txt`
